sources.description: The on-field portion of the 2026 NFL Scouting Combine kicked off on Thursday Night and the top defensive prospects in the 2026 NFL Draft did not disappoint. Ohio State linebacker Sonny Styles stole the show, but his teammate, linebacker/edge rusher Arvell Reese, also stood out. Reese cemented himself as a top 5 selection in the […]
